name: r6-auth-legacy
description: Legacy (unscoped) arm of the disabled_at and user_uuid probes. disabled_at stored as NULL, empty TEXT, TEXT, BLOB, empty BLOB, integer and real (TEXT affinity stores numbers as text). Each authenticated route that reads disabled_at; node-sqlite3 returns a Buffer for a BLOB (truthy, even empty). users.user_uuid as BLOB, empty BLOB, empty TEXT, integer and real (stored as text), and TEXT/BLOB twins with the same bytes. Node binds a Buffer back as a BLOB, so scope reads find the BLOB row and BLOB grants only; a Buffer is truthy. Record without --scoped.

steps.why: account with disabled_at CAST('2026-01-02' AS BLOB)
owner of zones granted to the probe accounts
user_uuid CAST('u-twin' AS BLOB) with a twin row holding the same bytes in the other storage class
user_uuid CAST('u-twin2' AS BLOB) with a twin row holding the same bytes in the other storage class
user_uuid 'u-twin3' with a twin row holding the same bytes in the other storage class
